description: CDC-« MI SENTI? »-Couverture mobile de la Corse is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. « MI SENTI? » Vous trouverez dans ce jeu de données un export des mesures réalisées à travers l’application mobile « Mi senti ? ». Il s’agit de mesures de la qualité de la couverture mobile en Corse réalisées par les utilisateurs de l’application. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. Its keywords are réseau, réseau mobile, 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G. The portal shows 20,896 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
